text.config.lodged.title: Lodged Configuration
text.config.lodged.category.arrowRecover: Controls how lodged arrows are tracked, preserved, and recovered.
text.config.lodged.category.arrowBreakag: Controls whether arrows can break when they hit entities or blocks.
text.config.lodged.category.playerArrowR: Controls removing lodged arrows from the inventory player preview.
text.config.lodged.category.arrowDepth.t: Controls shallow, lodged, and deep lodged arrow classification and effects.
text.config.lodged.category.shieldArrows: Controls arrows lodging into shields and how shield arrows are rendered.
Controls arrows lodging into armor pieces and how armor arrows are removed.
text.config.lodged.category.legShotSlown: Controls the Slowness effect applied when arrows hit player legs.
text.config.lodged.category.bleedingRule: Controls what can cause bleeding and how armor changes bleeding chances.
text.config.lodged.category.bleedingEffe: Controls bleeding durations, damage pulses, and drip particles.
Tracked lodged arrows can drop from living entities when they die.
Chance for each tracked lodged arrow to drop on death.
Maximum lodged arrows stored on a single entity. Set to 0 to disable tracking.
Only arrows fired by players can be recovered.
Arrows fired by mobs can be recovered from entity death drops and player body removal.
Survival Infinity-generated arrows can be recovered from entity death drops and player body removal.
Arrows fired by creative-mode players can be recovered.
Store the original arrow ItemStack so spectral and tipped arrow data can be recovered.
Arrows stuck in players will not naturally despawn from the vanilla stuck-arrow renderer.
Arrows stuck in non-player living entities will not naturally despawn from the vanilla stuck-arrow renderer.
Entity type IDs that should never track or drop lodged arrows.
Enable arrow break on entity hit
Arrows can break when they hit living entities.
Enable arrow break on block hit
Arrows can break when they hit blocks.
Arrows fired by non-player entities can break on impact.
Chance for each regular arrow to break immediately on impact.
Chance for each mob-fired arrow to break immediately on impact.
Chance for each survival Infinity-generated arrow to break immediately on impact.
text.config.lodged.option.playerArrowRem: Enable player arrow removal
Players can remove arrows lodged in their own body from the inventory player preview.
Show inventory turn hint
Shows a small rotation hint at the bottom of the inventory player preview.
Show inventory turn hint tooltip
Shows the controls tooltip when hovering the inventory turn hint.
Enable arrow removal animation
Shows the item flying to its destination slot or breaking after arrow removal.
Arrow removal animation speed
Multiplier for arrow removal animation speed. Higher values make the animation finish faster.
Head arrow removal success chance
Chance that removing a player arrow from the head succeeds and recovers the arrow item.
Chest arrow removal success chance
Chance that removing a player arrow from the chest succeeds and recovers the arrow item.
Arm arrow removal success chance
Chance that removing a player arrow from an arm succeeds and recovers the arrow item.
Leg arrow removal success chance
Chance that removing a player arrow from a leg succeeds and recovers the arrow item.
Infinity arrow removal success multiplier
Multiplier applied to player arrow removal success chance for Infinity-generated arrows. This only applies when Recover Infinity arrows is enabled.
Player arrow removal break damage
Damage dealt when player arrow removal fails and breaks the arrow. Damage is in half-hearts, so 2.0 equals one heart.
Arrow removal applies knockback
Failed arrow removal damage can push the player when the arrow breaks.
Allow arrow removal in Creative
Creative-mode players may remove arrows lodged in their own body.
Require inventory screen for removal
Removal requests are only accepted while the player is in their own inventory menu.
Max removable player arrows
Maximum player lodged arrows exposed to the inventory removal UI. Set to 0 to follow max tracked arrows per entity.
Enable lodged arrow dizziness
Players with many lodged arrows receive a subtle vignette, red tint, and screen wobble that grows stronger as more arrows lodge.
Dizziness arrow threshold
Minimum lodged arrows needed to apply dizziness. Set to 0 to use only the percentage threshold.
Dizziness max-arrow percentage
Percentage of max tracked arrows needed to apply dizziness. Set to 0 to use only the arrow-count threshold.
Dizziness duration
Ticks of Lodged's custom Dizziness effect applied while the player has enough lodged arrows.
Dizziness refresh interval
Ticks between dizziness refresh checks while lodged arrow dizziness is enabled.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.ena: Arrows can classify as shallow, lodged, or deep lodged. Disable to make all tracked body arrows normal lodged arrows.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.dee: Base deep lodged chance for head hits before bonuses and armor modifiers.
Base deep lodged chance for chest hits before bonuses and armor modifiers.
Base deep lodged chance for arm hits before bonuses and armor modifiers.
Base deep lodged chance for leg hits before bonuses and armor modifiers.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.sha: Shallow head chance
Chance for a non-deep head hit to become shallow instead of normal lodged.
Shallow chest chance
Chance for a non-deep chest hit to become shallow instead of normal lodged.
Shallow arm chance
Chance for a non-deep arm hit to become shallow instead of normal lodged.
Shallow leg chance
Chance for a non-deep leg hit to become shallow instead of normal lodged.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.vel: Arrow speed where velocity starts increasing deep lodged chance and reducing shallow chance.
Speed range over which the velocity bonus ramps from none to maximum.
Maximum deep lodged chance added by high arrow velocity.
Maximum shallow chance removed by high arrow velocity.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.cri: Deep lodged chance added when the arrow is critical.
Shallow chance removed when the arrow is critical.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.wea: Deep lodged chance added per point of extra vanilla-modified projectile damage.
Maximum deep lodged chance added from modified projectile damage.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.pow: Deep lodged chance added for each Power enchantment level on the firing bow.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.cro: Deep lodged chance added when the arrow was fired from a crossbow.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.arm: Multiplier applied to deep lodged chance when armor covers the hit body area.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.una: Deep lodged chance added for unarmored head or chest hits.
Deep lodged chance added for unarmored arm or leg hits.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.str: Power level that qualifies critical unarmored head/chest hits for the strong deep lodged chance.
Modified arrow damage that qualifies critical unarmored head/chest hits for the strong deep lodged chance.
Minimum deep lodged chance for critical unarmored head/chest hits that meet the Power or damage threshold.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.pow: Minimum deep lodged chance added per Power level for critical unarmored head/chest hits that meet the Power or damage threshold.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.fas: Arrow speed that qualifies critical unarmored head/chest hits for the fast critical minimum chance.
Minimum deep lodged chance for fast critical unarmored head/chest hits.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.pow: Power any body part chance per level
Minimum deep lodged chance per Power level for critical unarmored hits on any body part.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.dee: Base maximum deep lodged chance after all bonuses before Power increases the cap.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.pow: Power max chance bonus per level
Deep lodged max chance added for each Power enchantment level on the firing bow.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.sha: Shallow min chance
Minimum shallow chance after velocity and critical penalties.
Shallow max chance
Maximum shallow chance after velocity and critical penalties.
Shallow removal multiplier
Multiplier applied to removal success chance for shallow arrows.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.lod: Multiplier applied to removal success chance for normal lodged arrows.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.dee: Multiplier applied to removal success chance for deep lodged arrows.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.sha: Shallow bleeding chance multiplier
Multiplier applied to arrow-removal bleeding chance for shallow arrows.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.lod: Multiplier applied to arrow-removal bleeding chance for normal lodged arrows.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.dee: Multiplier applied to arrow-removal bleeding chance for deep lodged arrows.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.sha: Shallow bleeding duration multiplier
Multiplier applied to arrow-removal bleeding duration for shallow arrows.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.lod: Multiplier applied to arrow-removal bleeding duration for normal lodged arrows.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.dee: Multiplier applied to arrow-removal bleeding duration for deep lodged arrows.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.sha: Shallow removal animation
Milliseconds for the inventory removal animation after pulling a shallow arrow.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.lod: Milliseconds for the inventory removal animation after pulling a normal lodged arrow.
text.config.lodged.option.arrowDepth.dee: Milliseconds for the inventory removal animation after pulling a deep lodged arrow.
text.config.lodged.option.shieldArrows.e: Arrows blocked by shields can lodge into the shield item.
text.config.lodged.option.shieldArrows.r: Arrows fired by mobs can be recovered when removed from shields.
text.config.lodged.option.shieldArrows.m: Maximum lodged arrows stored on a shield. Set to 0 to follow max tracked arrows per entity.
text.config.lodged.option.shieldArrows.r: Shows lodged arrows on shields held by the local player in first person.
text.config.lodged.option.armorArrows.en: Arrows stopped by equipped armor can lodge into the armor item instead of the body.
text.config.lodged.option.armorArrows.re: Arrows fired by mobs can be recovered when removed from armor.
Shows lodged arrows stored on equipped armor pieces.
text.config.lodged.option.armorArrows.en: Armor with lodged arrows can take extra durability damage when it is hurt.
text.config.lodged.option.armorArrows.ma: Max tracked arrows per armor piece
Maximum lodged arrows stored on one armor piece. Set to 0 to follow max tracked arrows per entity.
text.config.lodged.option.armorArrows.ar: Armor arrow base penetration chance
Base chance for an arrow to penetrate armor and lodge in the body before armor defense is applied.
Armor defense penetration penalty
Penetration chance subtracted for each defense point on the hit armor piece.
Armor arrow min penetration chance
Lowest possible chance for an arrow to penetrate armor.
Armor arrow max penetration chance
Highest possible chance for an arrow to penetrate armor.
Armor arrow removal success chance
Chance that removing an armor arrow succeeds and recovers the arrow item.
Armor arrow removal time
Ticks required to pull an arrow out of armor in world.
Armor removal durability chance
Chance to damage the armor by 1 durability after successful armor arrow removal.
Armor removal break chance
Chance that an armor arrow breaks during in-world removal.
Armor break durability chance
Chance to damage the armor by 1 durability when an armor arrow breaks.
Lodged armor extra loss chance
Base chance that armor with lodged arrows takes extra durability damage when hurt.
Extra loss chance per additional arrow
Extra chance added for each lodged armor arrow beyond the first.
Lodged armor extra loss max chance
Maximum chance for lodged armor arrows to add extra durability damage.
Lodged armor extra loss amount
Additional durability damage applied when the lodged armor arrow penalty triggers.
text.config.lodged.option.legShotSlownes: Arrows that hit a player's legs apply vanilla Slowness without effect particles.
Ticks of Slowness applied by arrows that hit player legs. Set to 0 to prevent the effect.
Potion level applied by leg shots. Level 1 is Slowness I.
Enable bleeding
Lodged can apply its bleeding mob effect.
Arrow removal causes bleeding
Pulling lodged arrows out of your body can apply bleeding.
Enchantments cause bleeding
Weapons with enchantments in Lodged's bleeding enchantment tags can apply bleeding.
Weapons cause bleeding
Unenchanted weapons in the lodged:bleeding_weapons item tag can apply bleeding.
Skeletons affected by bleeding
Entity types in lodged:bleeding_skeletons can bleed.
Undead affected by bleeding
Undead entity types in lodged:bleeding_undead can bleed.
Full armor prevents bleeding
Wearing armor in all four normal armor slots prevents new bleeding.
Partial armor prevents bleeding
Wearing any normal armor piece prevents new bleeding.
Full armor bleeding chance
Chance for bleeding to apply with full armor when full armor prevention is disabled.
Partial armor bleeding chance
Chance for bleeding to apply with one to three armor pieces.
No armor bleeding chance
Chance for bleeding to apply with no armor pieces.
Failed arrow removal full armor bleeding chance
Chance for failed arrow removal to apply bleeding with full armor.
Failed arrow removal partial armor bleeding chance
Chance for failed arrow removal to apply bleeding with one to three armor pieces.
Failed arrow removal no armor bleeding chance
Chance for failed arrow removal to apply bleeding with no armor pieces.
text.config.lodged.option.bleedingEffect: Bleeding damage duration
Bleeding duration added by qualifying weapon damage.
Arrow removal bleeding duration
Bleeding duration added by pulling out a lodged arrow.
Max bleeding duration
Maximum bleeding duration after stacking repeated triggers.
Strong bleeding threshold
Bleeding becomes stronger at or above this remaining duration.
Bleeding tick interval
Ticks between damage pulses for normal bleeding.
Strong bleeding tick interval
Ticks between damage pulses for strong bleeding.
Bleeding damage
Damage dealt by each normal bleeding pulse.
Strong bleeding damage
Damage dealt by each strong bleeding pulse.
Lodged blood particles
Shows Lodged blood particles for bleeding in world and on the inventory player preview.
Simple Blood compat particles
Allows Lodged blood drops to spawn Simple Blood ground decals when that mod is installed. Requires Lodged blood particles.
Simple Blood decal chance
Chance for each landed Lodged blood drop to spawn a Simple Blood ground decal.
Simple Blood decal scale multiplier
Multiplier applied to the Lodged blood drop size before clamping the Simple Blood decal scale.
Simple Blood decal min scale
Smallest Simple Blood ground decal scale Lodged can spawn.
Simple Blood decal max scale
Largest Simple Blood ground decal scale Lodged can spawn.
Simple Blood decal random min scale
Lowest random multiplier applied after clamping the Simple Blood decal scale.
Simple Blood decal random max scale
Highest random multiplier applied after clamping the Simple Blood decal scale.
Bleeding drip interval
Ticks between blood drip particles for normal bleeding.
Strong bleeding drip interval
Ticks between blood drip particles for strong bleeding.
